dict.string:
1.1.54: the flashing button is finally identified, and it is not the one every previous build was chasing. The navigation bar has its own download control — a separate 28x28 MusicCoreUI.SymbolButton from the header's, which is why the two were indistinguishable in every log until 1.1.53 sampled the bar itself. The flash is a gate, not a delay: the install looks up play and shuffle first and returns early if either is missing, so during the second Music spends building the header asynchronously, nothing has been hidden at all — while the nav bar is painted from the first frame. Making the retry faster could never fix that, which is why 1.1.52 cut the header gap to a third and the flash survived. The nav button is now covered before that gate, and put back the moment the glass row is installed, because our row scrolls away with the artwork and the nav bar's button is the only download control left after that.
1.1.53: no visible change — this build exists to identify the button that is still flashing. The one in the header row is accounted for: 1.1.52 cut the gap from 1.2s average to 0.3s, measured across nine album opens. What is left is the red button at the top of the screen, which lives in the navigation bar and so is not in this page's view at all. 1.1.52 could only report that three unnamed items exist there. This build looks one level in — at each item's own view and its children — and samples twice, 0.05s and 1.5s after the page appears, because a single sample cannot show a flash. It also removes a nav-bar matcher that would have returned the “•••” menu as the download control; it has never fired on 17.3, but wrong-by-construction and merely unreached is still wrong.
1.1.52: the remaining download flash had a measurable cause. Every album open logged the same pair a second apart — the play and shuffle controls exist as soon as the header builds, and the download control arrives about a second later. The install reported success as soon as the row was placed, which told the retry timer there was nothing left to wait for, so nothing was watching for the control that had not turned up yet and Music's own red one stayed uncovered for that second. Success now means the download control was found too. The separate red button that appears at the top of the screen is not in this page's view at all, so this build names it in status.log rather than hiding something it has not identified.
1.1.51: the download glyph was smaller and paler than the shuffle glyph beside it, and the two could not have matched — shuffle was a symbol drawn at a chosen point size, download was a photograph of Apple’s control with whatever margin Apple left around it. So neither picks its own size now: every glyph in the row is trimmed to its real bounding box, redrawn to one fixed box, and contrast-stretched so a single-colour glyph lands flat at full strength while a progress ring keeps its dark arc and pale track apart. The placeholder arrow goes through the same path as the mirror, which is why the handover between them is no longer visible.
Turning Enable Music27 OFF removes the dock and other chrome immediately. Dock never mutates safe-area insets, never hides Library/MiniPlayer hosts, and never adds subviews to Music's key window.
Hide Stock Tab Bar / Mini Player
Relaunch Music after changing toggles if a surface does not update.
Music27 1.1.54 — the flash was the nav bar's own download button. Verified on iOS 17.3; 16.7 untested.
